ui.chat.sidebar_view.relative_short.note: All units are selected from numeric elapsed time, never parsed from translated text. Preserve the selected basis; adapt unit abbreviations idiomatically. Width is advisory, not a truncation instruction.

placeholders.unit: Internal select token: now, minute, hour, day, week, year. Do not translate token names.
placeholders.count: Non-negative elapsed quantity; use locale digits and plural rules.
